column4: click "2D" in the surface strip; state view3d.wf.on 1 -> 0 and cfg.view3d contains waterfall:on=0
click "3D SURFACE"; state view3d.wf.on 0 -> 1, cfg.view3d contains waterfall:on=1
state view3d.wf.renders, triangles, pixels, data, realrows (what the renderer drew from the live history)
slider "ELEVATION" 0.5; state view3d.wf.elevation 44..49
slider "AZIMUTH" 0.75; state view3d.wf.azimuth 85..95
click "30 s"; state view3d.wf.depth == 0
click "60 s"; state view3d.wf.depth == 1
click "120 s"; state view3d.wf.depth == 2
click "Height"; state view3d.wf.shading == 0
click "Colour ramp"; state view3d.wf.shading == 1
click "RESET VIEW"; state view3d.wf.elevation 32, azimuth -58, zoom 1
the scripted input has no drag verb and no wheel-notch count on the well; test_slint_scene3d_well.cpp drives the drag, the wheel and the double-click in a window against the shared rules
press "Waterfall"; key left / up / + / - / 0; state view3d.wf.azimuth, elevation, zoom

state cfg.view3d contains waterfall:on=1 after the toggle and waterfall:on=0 after the way back (the host-held interface half; a real run writes it, test_config and test_slint_host_view3d hold the field and the text)
click "PPI"; state view3d.radar.on 1 -> 0, scope.tubeW > 300 again
click "3D AIRSPACE"; state view3d.radar.on 0 -> 1, cfg.view3d contains radar:on=1
state view3d.radar.renders, aircraft, onground, pixels, labels (what the renderer drew from the plotted aircraft)
slider "TILT" 0.5; state view3d.radar.tilt 43..47
click "x1"; state view3d.radar.scale == 0
click "x2"; state view3d.radar.scale == 1
click "x4"; state view3d.radar.scale == 2
click "RESET VIEW"; state view3d.radar.tilt 26, azimuth -40
the scripted input has no drag verb and no wheel-notch count on the well; test_slint_scene3d_well.cpp drives the drag, the wheel and the double-click in a window against the shared rules
press "Airspace"; key left, +, -; state view3d.radar.azimuth, zoom
state cfg.view3d contains radar:on=1 and radar:on=0 after the way back
click "VECTOR"#2 (the toggle's own key); state view3d.tunnel.on 1 -> 0, cfg.view3d contains tunnel:on=0
click "3D TUNNEL"; state view3d.tunnel.on 0 -> 1, cfg.view3d contains tunnel:on=1
state view3d.tunnel.renders, points, pixels, labels, w, h (what the renderer drew from the scope's I/Q)
slider "TIME DEPTH" 0 / 1 / 0.5333; state view3d.tunnel.depth 0 / 15 / 8 and depthms, points
click "Time" / "Level"; state view3d.tunnel.colour 0 / 1
click "RESET VIEW"; state view3d.tunnel.azimuth -35, zoom 1
the scripted input has no drag verb and no wheel-notch count on the well; test_slint_scene3d_well.cpp drives the drag, the wheel and the double-click in a window against the shared rules
press "Tunnel"; key left, +; state view3d.tunnel.azimuth, zoom
state cfg.view3d contains tunnel:on=1 and tunnel:on=0 after the way back
click "TABLE"; state view3d.survey.on 1 -> 0, cfg.view3d contains survey:on=0
click "3D SURFACE"; state view3d.survey.on 0 -> 1, cfg.view3d contains survey:on=1
state view3d.survey.renders, channels, triangles, pixels, labels, first (the real plugin row)
slider "ELEVATION" 0.5; state view3d.survey.elevation 44..49
slider "AZIMUTH" 0.75; state view3d.survey.azimuth 85..95
click "RESET VIEW"; state view3d.survey.elevation 36, azimuth -52
the scripted input has no drag verb and no wheel-notch count on the well; test_slint_scene3d_well.cpp drives the drag, the wheel and the double-click in a window against the shared rules
press "Survey"; key left, +, 0; state view3d.survey.azimuth, zoom
state view3d.survey.ranked >= 3 (the rank numbers placed; the list quotes the same rows)
state cfg.view3d contains survey:on=1 and survey:on=0 after the way back
